title: Task 3 – Upload an AppBundle to the Automation Service

rows.Description: Creates a new alias for the AppBundle.
Creates a new version of the AppBundle.

Contains a description of the add-in, including the GUIDs and relative path to the add-in. For more information on
PackageContents.xml, see PackageContents.xml Format Reference
The TypeScript file that will be executed with the fusion api
The name given to the AppBundle.

The engine that the AppBundle must be loaded on; Fusion latest in this case.
For more information on engine aliases, see the Additional Notes section at the bottom of this page.
The URL you must upload the AppBundle zip file to.
The version number of the AppBundle created by the POST request. For new AppBundles, the returned version is always 1.
The form data that must accompany the AppBundle when you upload it to endpointURL. formData expires in 3600 seconds.

codeExamples.raw:
curl -X POST \
  'https://developer.api.autodesk.com/da/us-east/v3/appbundles' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
        "id": "ConfigureDesignAppBundle",
        "engine": "Autodesk.Fusion+Latest",
        "description": "My first fusion appbundle based on the latest Fusion engine"
      }'

parsed.description: My first fusion appbundle based on the latest Fusion engine
